TC-14/S07.title: Tap Generate, then leave for another patient, reload or close the tab: on return the note is there or an explicit failure shows, and nothing lands on the other patient
TC-14/S07.detail: PW, local stack, one fresh physician per mode; ai/notes:generateNote mocked at the Convex socket and answered 8 s after it is asked with a note that carries the dictation (so each cell's blood pressure tells its note apart). Every Generate used a 'procedure-other' custom note template because on 43c38a4f saving a generated note queues a server billing job (billing/persistence.ts enqueueBilling → ai/billing.ts run) that no socket mock can answer and that would reach Bedrock on this stack; the template only changes the (mocked) model's instruction text. Tripwire: no model call at all during the run. Cell A (Hospital, Generate then the app's back arrow and the list to a second patient, 45 s there, back): passed 8/8 — the second patient never showed or stored anything of the first (Post-Round 'No note generated yet', no note / noteGeneratedAt / encounter text), and on return the first patient's Post-Round showed its own note (131/77) at once and 30 s later, dictation kept. Cell C (Nursing Home, same): passed 8/8. Cell B (Hospital, Generate, reload while the generateNote request is in flight, 144 ms after the press): FAILED — 45 s later Post-Round shows only 'No note generated yet. Complete the Encounter tab first.' with the finalize button spinning 'Finalizing Encounter Data…' (B27); no note was stored (status stays 'seen'); the dictation is kept. Cell D (both modes, Regenerate with new dictation, open a new tab and close the old one): FAILED in both — 45 s later Post-Round still shows the previous note (131/77, 127/69) as the current note with no sign that the regenerate was lost, while the stored encounter text is the new dictation (136/84, 133/71). On 43c38a4f the note is still generated by the page: the browser calls ai/notes:generateNote, gets the text back and saves it with its own mutation (useNoteGeneration.ts finalize, snf EncounterTab.tsx handleGenerate); 'feat: use jobs for generation' (68f81eca) moved only the billing suggestion to a server job (no scheduler use for notes anywhere in convex/). Judged 20/23 (failures b1, d1, d3; the B27 spinner is recorded only). Dev confirmation of cell B with the real backend: runs/2026-10-14-dev/newspec-c/results.gen.json TC-14/S07.
TC-14/S07.productIssue: A physician who taps Generate Note & Finish and then reloads, closes the tab, or (on a phone) has the page killed loses the note silently: on return Post-Round says 'No note generated yet. Complete the Encounter tab first.' with a spinning 'Finalizing Encounter Data…' button, and after a Regenerate the old note is shown as if it were current. The dictation is kept, so Generate can be pressed again.
